footprint_and_position.transform_note: Approximate local campus conversion specified in modular/AGENTS.md; not a surveyed CRS.
footprint_and_position.result: OSM wall polygon exactly matches manifest placeholder XY extents to source precision; using polygon vertices instead of placeholder bounding box.

vertical_and_architecture.modeled_story_assumption: Single main wall level under a tall sanctuary roof; qualitative estimate from exterior photographs, not a verified count.
vertical_and_architecture.roof_form: Steep gabled sanctuary roof with an asymmetric raised north-facing gable/swept fascia; simple lower roof over west shoulder. Photo-supported form, estimated dimensions and pitch.
vertical_and_architecture.facade: Warm buff brick walls, teal vertical gable cladding, broad triangular stained glass with restrained mullions, dark shingle roof, and cross; door placement and all opening dimensions are approximate.
remaining_uncertainty: No dimensioned elevation, roof schedule, or verified height was found; every vertical dimension is estimated from unscaled perspectives.
Story count is not documented in the available GIS/OSM or church website material; the above-ground wall level is a visual approximation.
The building was expanded in 1994; available OSM polygon likely reflects current exterior but source history does not identify which addition boundary is which.
The queried ArcGIS FID 823 is a nearby Fairway cooperative building and is not the church.

Kept manifest object name, collection, scene, one-object export, and asset path stable.
